results.title: Murder in Music City
results.overview: When a rising young musician is found murdered at the estate of country music legend Abilene Tucker, all evidence points to the scandal-plagued diva. But as her estranged daughter Caroline digs for the truth, she uncovers a web of obsession.

results.title: A Chardonnay for Love
results.overview: When small-town writer Samantha Lane lands a career-making assignment to profile Maple Creek's local winemaker and most eligible bachelor, William Crew, her dream of moving to New York is tested by a deeper story.

results.title: Alice and Horst
results.overview: Alice and Horst paints a moving portrait of two siblings from Saarbrücken whose lives were shaped by their family’s antifascist resistance. As children, Alice Hornung and Horst Bernard were forced to flee from the Nazis into exile in France, where, despite constant danger, they also experienced great solidarity. After their return they continued their parents’ political commitment: against fascism, for peace and disarmament. The film combines personal memories with rare archival footage and portrays two individuals who, well into old age, remain unwavering in their commitment to justice and remembrance.

results.title: Bob and David Climb Machu Picchu
results.original_title: Bob and David Climb Machu Picchu
results.overview: Comedy legends Bob Odenkirk and David Cross tackle one of the world's toughest hikes — and each other — in this high-altitude, coca-fueled meditation on friendship, mortality, and profoundly absurd comedy from two icons still magnificently in sync.

results.title: Heartin
results.overview: Fate tosses a couple into an unexpected situation with an ex-girlfriend in the mix.

results.title: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
results.original_title: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
results.overview: Jo Koy relives a wild dental disaster, recounts getting fired from McDonald's and celebrates his veteran stepdad in this hilariously heartfelt set.

results.title: Extraordinary
results.overview: When ten-year-old Alice's parents mysteriously vanish one day, she turns to a spirited group of young detectives for help. Their mission becomes more challenging when her brother Milan must join their investigation. He can't be left alone, and wherever Alice goes, he goes too. Milan sees and experiences the world differently, and what starts as a complication soon becomes their greatest strength. The children discover creative and heartwarming ways to connect with Milan, and his unique perspective proves invaluable to their detective work. Together, this unlikely team embarks on an extraordinary adventure, unraveling clues and solving a mystery bigger than they ever imagined. Through friendship, understanding, and courage, they not only crack the case but also discover something even more precious: the power of acceptance, the magic of true teamwork, and bonds that will last a lifetime.

results.title: Alex & MOR: A Love Odyssey
results.overview: A couple seeks to reunite through space and time, as one relives the first day they met, and the other wakes up in the desert without memory of their relationship.

results.title: The Knight of the Sorrowful Figure
results.original_title: The Knight of the Sorrowful Figure
results.overview: Don Quixote and Sancho Panza set forth on their quest in search of honor, chivalry, and legacy.

results.title: Srinivasa Mangapuram
results.overview: Vasu Babu and Manga are living in their own blissful world, until a ruthless threat targets their romance. As powerful enemies move to separate them, Vasu must fight for his woman.

results.title: XO
results.overview: They are two. They play a game, fight and compete, love and wander, yearn and mourn. They part and reunite, get bored and create, scream and dream. But can they defy the duality?

results.title: Nachts in der Provinz
results.overview: Richard runs a sausage stand at the local sports ground. When a young woman appears, searching for her runaway horse, he is pulled out of his familiar routine. Together, they set off to find it – and an unusual night begins. Elsewhere, as dusk falls, Anna faces a different kind of departure. After one final shift as a pizza delivery driver, she plans to leave her home village for good. But old relationships, village stories and a ghostly encounter make her wonder whether leaving is really that simple.

results.title: Wolf Ticket
results.overview: A down on his luck man purchases the secret to success: a ticket that turns the buyer into a werewolf.

results.title: Borges’ Cat
results.overview: In a Buenos Aires movie theater, a group of strangers is trapped during a violent confrontation in the streets. While chaos reigns outside, fears, ideals, and secrets surface inside, and each person must face who they really are.

results.title: Tox
results.overview: After transforming herself, through years of plastic surgery a woman returns to confront the past that scarred her – only to discover that perfection carries a cost she can no longer escape. As Catherine prepares for what she believes will be the most important night of her life, her inner turmoil surfaces, revealing the destructive cycle of perfectionism, body dysmorphia, and addiction to external validation. As tensions rise between her and Abby, a young, fiery assistant who sees through the illusion, Catherine is forced to confront a haunting past and the mask she's spent years perfecting.

results.title: Glückspilze isst man nicht
results.overview: The eccentric scientist Frieda Hofstätter is on the verge of being cast aside. Then the Valkyrie Wolkentruth appears to take her to Valhalla. But Frieda refuses and strikes a deal: Wolkentruth must help her save Frieda’s CO2-storing miracle mushroom. Only then may she take Frieda with her. Together, they race against time—and perhaps for the future of the world.

results.title: Seniors
results.overview: A high school senior goes on his first college campus tour the day his parents’ marriage begins to fracture.

results.title: Call of My Life
results.overview: The romantic comedy follows Soluchi, a hopeless romantic still healing from being jilted by her former lover, Kalu. When a regular work call puts her in touch with the charming Eli, Soluchi begins to see the possibility of the love story she has always wanted.
